title.zh: 将金达沃省Compostela市镇的孔波斯特拉谷州立学院更名为金达沃州立学院的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Compostela Valley State College in the Municipality of Compostela, Province of Davao De Oro to the Davao De Oro State College
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Compostela Valley State College in the Municipality of Compostela, Province of Davao De Oro to the Davao De Oro State College
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Cao đẳng Bang Compostela Valley tại Đô thị Compostela, Tỉnh Davao De Oro thành Cao đẳng Bang Davao De Oro
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อวิทยาลัยของรัฐ Compostela Valley ในเทศบาล Compostela จังหวัด Davao De Oro เป็นวิทยาลัยของรัฐ Davao De Oro
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Tinggi Negeri Compostela Valley di Kotamadya Compostela, Provinsi Davao De Oro menjadi Sekolah Tinggi Negeri Davao De Oro
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Kolej Negeri Compostela Valley di Perbandaran Compostela, Wilayah Davao De Oro kepada Kolej Negeri Davao De Oro

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2021/ra_11575_2021.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Compostela Valley State College in the Municipality of Compostela, Province of Davao de Oro is hereby renamed as the Davao de Oro State College.
The provisions of Republic Act No. 8292, otherwise known as the “Higher Education Modernization Act of 1997”, shall form part of this Act and the Governing Charter of the College.
All laws, executive orders, decrees, instructions, rules and regulations contrary to or inconsistent with any provisions of this Act are amended, repealed or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
